supplied_requirements.grip: Six equally spaced shallow scallops, minimum grip diameter 33 mm, nominal 1 mm exposed rounds and subtle raised dots.
supplied_requirements.socket: Concentric blind D socket, 10 mm deep, derived from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm shaft across-flat distance with 0.20 mm radial and flat clearance; at least 3 mm material above; no insert, set screw, taper or keyway.
supplied_requirements.manufacturing: PETG; P1S; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.20 mm layers; four walls; 35% infill; installed matching profiles required.
supplied_requirements.tolerance: Proposed ±0.25 mm on non-mating surfaces; socket design values remain separate from later measurements.
supplied_requirements.limitations: No geometry, fit, strength, dimensional-accuracy, standards or print-success claim.

proposed_geometry.coordinate_basis: Axis Z; rear/socket face at Z=0, main front face at Z=16, hub top at Z=18; socket depth proceeds +Z from its rear opening.

scallops.phase: Radius maxima at 0°+60°k; scallop minima at 30°+60°k, k=0..5.

hub.placement: Concentric on the front face from Z=16 to Z=18.

dots.placement: Domed dots on the main front face, centers on radius 14.0 mm at 0°+30°k; their tops reach Z=16.35 and remain below the hub top.
dots.transition: Smooth tangent dome/base blend without undercut.

rounds.treatment: Nominal R1 fillets on external front and rear scalloped perimeter edges and the hub top perimeter; dot transitions are domed. Socket boundaries and mouth remain unrounded to preserve the defined mating section and avoid an invented taper.

socket.construction: Start with the shaft circle radius 3.00 mm. Because 5.20 mm is flat-to-far-round, locate the shaft flat at x=-2.20 mm relative to the center. Apply 0.20 mm radial clearance to obtain radius 3.20 mm and move the flat outward by 0.20 mm to x=-2.40 mm. The cavity section is the disk x²+y²≤3.20² clipped by x≥-2.40 mm.
socket.features_excluded: No insert, set screw, taper or keyway.

proposed_geometry.orientation: Propose slicing with the rear socket opening upward and the front hub toward the build plate; exclude support from the socket and propose build-plate support beneath unsupported front-face regions, subject to preview review.

basis_review: Approve the sinusoidal 34–38 mm six-scallop outline, stated phase and 2 mm radial depth.
Approve the 12 mm hub, twelve 1.4×0.35 mm domed dots and external R1 treatment.
Approve the D-boundary derivation, flat side/phase, +Z blind-depth direction and unrounded socket mouth.
Approve socket-up orientation, no socket support, and proposed build-plate support beneath the front-side overhangs.
Approve the planned package: distinct source and repaired meshes, support/slicing preview, repaired-revision-bound P1S PETG 3MF, and digest-bound local simulator receipt only.
remaining_verification: Inspect generated geometry for envelope, wall/roof dimensions, rounds, dot blending, manifold condition and correspondence to the approved basis.
Inspect repaired-mesh lineage and confirm the slice package binds to that revision.
Inspect actual orientation, generated supports, socket exclusion and slicing preview.
Verify installed matching P1S 0.4 mm PETG profiles and the 0.20 mm, four-wall and 35% settings.
Inspect final package contents and hashes; later measure and test actual socket fit separately. No physical transfer or print start is authorized.
